## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Noosa Heads, Australia. It starts at Parkyn Parade.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Australia's marine life already has incredible diversity, and you can see a slice of the sea inside SEA LIFE. Disney lovers can rejoice in the special collaboration between Pixar and the aquarium that showcases the animals of Finding Dory. The collab also offers up fun games like an echolocation maze.
>
> Find out just how smart seals are and learn more about them as they play with their trainers, and marvel at sand tiger sharks – this is the only place in Queensland that houses them!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €27.79. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 97 ratings and 54 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
